name: bulk-email-tool
description: Serverless bulk email tool for sending to a self-managed subscriber list, with named groups and unsubscribe support. Built on AWS SES + Lambda + DynamoDB, deployed with CDK, admin frontend on Cloudflare Pages behind Access.

scripts.deploy: npm run build:shared && npm run build:lambdas && npm run cdk:deploy
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w frontend
